about_title: Take Control of Your Digital Life
about_subtitle: The next-generation open-source security engine built by an independent developer and AI.
about_p1: DewSecure was born from a simple vision: to return control of the internet to the user. We believe you should decide what content you see, not advertisers and pervasive trackers.
about_p2: This is more than an interception tool; it's a privacy sandbox deeply integrating device-side AI and cloud federated learning. With 110,000+ precise rules and a 3-class AI model dual-engine, we purify your network environment in milliseconds.
about_p3: As a fully open-source software (Open Core), DewSecure's core engine code is open to scrutiny by global developers. We refuse to sell user data or engage in black-box operations. We sustain the project's independence and purity through micro-subscriptions that protect your privacy.
trans_home_desc: The web is dynamic and tracking technologies keep evolving, so we cannot guarantee a 100% block rate. Due to platform limitations, certain in-app ads (e.g., YouTube App) cannot be blocked. However, DewSecure evolves continuously through AI to provide you with the strongest filtering experience possible.
trans_about_p1: 1. Technical & Platform Limitations: DewSecure is committed to providing top-tier content optimization and security. However, due to underlying network architecture and platform restrictions (e.g., YouTube App-specific ads, ads served from the same domain as content), we cannot achieve a 100% interception rate across all platforms.
trans_about_p2: 2. Dynamic Web Environment: Internet ads and tracking technologies are constantly updating. We cannot guarantee that the tool will permanently block all future evasion techniques.
trans_about_p3: 3. Commitment to Continuous Evolution: Despite the impossibility of perfection, DewSecure's AI models and DNR rule libraries iterate automatically every week. We strive to minimize the lifespan of 'escaped' ads and create the purest web environment for you.
free_desc: Completely free. Cleans most web content, works without logging in, and has no forced subscriptions. Register and log in to instantly activate a 30-day Pro experience. If it meets your needs, you can use it forever for free.
pro_desc: Designed for users seeking the ultimate experience. Unlock full AI blocking and seamless cross-platform sync.
fam_desc: Protect your whole family's digital security. Supports up to 9 devices simultaneously.
tooltip_desc: Browser A and Browser B on the same PC count as 2 devices. Android A + PC Browser A count as 2 devices. To use on a new device, simply paste your invite link into the extension on Device B to activate. You can unbind anytime.
guide_subtitle: From installation to ultimate experience in 1 minute.
guide_step1_desc: Go to the homepage, select your browser, and download. Drag the file into your browser's extension management page (chrome://extensions/) to install.
guide_step2_desc: Upon installation, DewSecure automatically activates 110,000+ blocking rules locally. Click the icon in the top right to view stats and enable AI protection.
guide_step3_desc: For Pro/Family users, generate an invite link in your Dashboard, paste it into the extension on a new device, and it will automatically activate.
faq1_q: Why can't some YouTube ads be blocked?
faq1_a: DewSecure fully respects and supports the YouTube creator ecosystem. Therefore, we do not purify YouTube-specific pre-roll ads or recommended products that are directly tied to creator revenue. We focus our efforts on malicious pop-ups, phishing, and trackers.
faq2_a: Some sites use dynamic scripts. When blocked, placeholders may remain. Use the feedback button, and we will optimize the hiding rules.
faq3_a: Absolutely. All matching and AI inference happen locally in your sandbox. We do not collect your browsing history.
faq4_q: How are devices counted for Pro/Family?
faq4_a: Different browsers on the same PC (e.g., Chrome+Edge) count as 2 devices. Android + PC browser also count as 2. Generate an 'Invite Link' in your Dashboard, and family members can paste it into their extension to activate. You can unbind old devices in the dashboard.
faq5_a: Internet ads and tracking technologies are constantly updating. Some sites deeply integrate ads with content (same-origin). Blocking them causes layout issues. We prioritize web usability and iterate AI models weekly to minimize escaped ads.
guide_trial_desc: Each account can activate a 30-Day Pro version once. Simply log in on the Login/Register page, and the system will automatically check your eligibility. Click 'Activate 30-Day Pro' to use full features. Note: Only one activation per account.
guide_trial_note: ⚠️ To prevent abuse, temporary emails (e.g., 10minutemail) cannot be used. Please use a valid email address.
feat_desc_7: Prevent malicious websites from using your device to silently mine cryptocurrency. Save CPU power and battery life.
faq6_q: Can DewSecure stop websites from stealing my CPU power for crypto mining?
faq6_a:
Yes, and highly effectively. 'Web mining' refers to malicious sites silently running complex scripts in the background to earn cryptocurrency while you browse. This causes severe device heating, loud fans, high power consumption, and lag.

[Basic Protection in Free Version] DewSecure's built-in 110,000+ rules already block all known malicious mining domains globally.

[Advanced Protection in Pro Version] To fight evolving hidden mining scripts, the Pro version uses an on-device AI model to detect and block unknown scripts via behavioral features, ensuring 100% of your computing power stays yours.
faq7_q: Can DewSecure completely eliminate annoying pop-up ads?
faq7_a:
Yes. Pop-ups not only block content, but modern ones often 'lurk' in the background, appearing only when you click anywhere or try to close the page. DewSecure enables powerful blocking by default, cutting them off early. Also, for 'tracking codes' that follow your browsing (e.g., searching for shoes and seeing shoe ads everywhere), our 110,000+ rules precisely sever their tracking paths.

💡 Tip: Not all pop-ups are bad (e.g., login prompts). If a normal pop-up is blocked by mistake, you can always add it to your 'Whitelist' in the extension panel.
faq8_q: Do web ads really spread viruses or trojans?
faq8_a:
Yes. This is called 'Malvertising'. Hackers disguise viruses, trojans, or ransomware as normal download buttons or ads. Once misclicked, malware silently downloads in the background.

DewSecure is not just an ad blocker; it's a security engine. We cut off network requests from these suspicious ad servers, preventing malicious code from entering your computer.

🛡️ Security Tip: Use DewSecure to block malicious ads along with your antivirus software. Never click 'Download' on shady websites.
